problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 10 cargo shipments through 10 different port terminals.

Each shipment consists of a series of handling steps represented as (Terminal, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the terminal where the handling must occur and the time required. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which handling steps must be performed.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (T1, 2) → (T6, 5) → (T9, 7) → (T7, 2) → (T4, 8) → (T3, 10) → (T5, 6) → (T8, 10) → (T2, 6) → (T10, 7)
* S2 requires the sequence: (T2, 9) → (T10, 2) → (T1, 5) → (T9, 7) → (T5, 7) → (T6, 5) → (T3, 6) → (T8, 8) → (T4, 1) → (T7, 4)
* S3 requires the sequence: (T5, 10) → (T6, 3) → (T7, 1) → (T8, 5) → (T3, 10) → (T1, 5) → (T10, 10) → (T4, 4) → (T9, 9) → (T2, 6)
* S4 requires the sequence: (T9, 5) → (T4, 7) → (T10, 6) → (T2, 6) → (T5, 5) → (T8, 7) → (T6, 6) → (T3, 4) → (T1, 1) → (T7, 7)
* S5 requires the sequence: (T3, 8) → (T6, 8) → (T2, 9) → (T8, 3) → (T7, 9) → (T5, 7) → (T9, 2) → (T4, 10) → (T10, 10) → (T1, 4)
* S6 requires the sequence: (T8, 4) → (T7, 4) → (T6, 10) → (T5, 7) → (T2, 10) → (T1, 9) → (T9, 3) → (T10, 3) → (T3, 1) → (T4, 4)
* S7 requires the sequence: (T2, 4) → (T1, 6) → (T4, 7) → (T5, 9) → (T9, 7) → (T6, 2) → (T7, 6) → (T8, 10) → (T3, 2) → (T10, 6)
* S8 requires the sequence: (T7, 2) → (T2, 6) → (T6, 6) → (T1, 5) → (T10, 3) → (T8, 8) → (T3, 7) → (T9, 4) → (T5, 4) → (T4, 2)
* S9 requires the sequence: (T2, 2) → (T7, 1) → (T3, 8) → (T4, 3) → (T5, 4) → (T6, 6) → (T9, 10) → (T8, 1) → (T1, 2) → (T10, 9)
* S10 requires the sequence: (T9, 5) → (T5, 9) → (T3, 5) → (T8, 7) → (T7, 10) → (T4, 6) → (T1, 8) → (T6, 5) → (T2, 1) → (T10, 1)

Each handling step must run continuously once initiated and cannot be interrupted, and each terminal can only handle one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all handling steps at the terminals so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
